newsitem.title: MEXICO: Sidek to seek OTC issue.
newsitem.headline: Sidek to seek OTC issue.

text.p: Mexico's Grupo Sidek, a troubled holding company with large steel and tourism interests, will seek to issue shares over the counter in New York, the company said on Monday.

Sidek announced its intension just days after the New York Stock Exchange suspended trading of Sidek ADRs on Friday. The NYSE said it would seek a delisting of Sidek shares because it had fallen below the exchange's criteria for net tangible assets and three-year average net income.

"Nonetheless, Sidek remains a public company in the United States under rules of the Securities and Exchange Commission and will immediately proceed to register its ADR securities representing its B and L series in the over the counter market under a program sponsored by The Bank of New York," Sidek said in a statement sent to the Mexican stock exchange.
